messages: maya: Quick sync — product needs a clear rule for preemptive headroom behavior at billing boundaries. Customers see burst charges split across months and are confused.
sam: Saw two customer tickets. Asks: 1) avoid double-charging when burst spans windows, 2) predictable preemption behavior during end-of-window spikes.
jon: Operational constraints: Dedicated pools use soft-shed + eviction. Preemption now is LRU-ish and can evict best-effort immediately.
liz: Ops wants something predictable and contract-friendly. Customers asked for a short 'grace window' so tiny bursts at month end don't bill full next window.
anya: From sales: customers would accept a small amortized carryover if explicitly stated in contract — helps churn. Make it opt-in for Dedicated.
sam: Proposal primitives: W_align (alignment window), H_preempt (preemptive headroom), eviction tiers: reserved, preemptive, best-effort.
maya: PM handoff launch criteria: spec doc + example configs, SLA text for opt-in carryover, rollout plan (pilot 3 customers), telemetry + chaos tests.
jon: Ops checklist: tracing hook for 'carryover_used', alert if H_preempt >20% pool for >5m, rollback to toggle off feature flag.

sam: Prototype config suggestion:
autoscale:
  alignment_window: 600
  preemptive_headroom: 0.05
  carryover_policy: "proportional"
  carryover_cap: 0.10
  eviction_order: [reserved, preemptive_headroom, best_effort]
liz: Billing question: if carryover > carryover_cap, do we bill the spill immediately or in the next window?
maya: Proposal: carryover shields up to cap. Excess spill is billed in current window to keep billing simple.
anya: Good. Need a one-pager for customers explaining carryover and cost impact.
jon: Two tricky points: 1) fairness — long-tailed tenants could hoard H_preempt, 2) runtime complexity detecting exact window boundaries (timezones + billing offsets).
sam: Mitigations: time-based decay so H_preempt expires at end of alignment window and is not renewable in same window. Use billing_clock metadata for offsets.
maya: Decision needed: defaults (alignment_window=10m, preemptive_headroom=5%). Owners: @sam runtime, @jon ops, @liz contracts, @anya sales.
sam: Eng action items: prototype flags + metrics (carryover_used, carryover_spilled), perf test to ensure <5% latency tail increase, AB test toggle per-customer.
jon: Ops action items: pool-level carryover dashboard, oncall doc for disabling carryover, month-boundary soak test.
maya: Timeline: spec + mini-RFC next Tue, eng prototype + ops dashboard in 2 weeks, pilot month after, GA after pilot (target 8 weeks).
maya: I'll file the RFC and include sample contract language. Tagging owners. ops-bot: reminder — weekly capacity sync tomorrow 11:00am PT.
